title: Map a no-replace publication AlreadyExists race to the typed destination refusals
outcome: Map a no-replace publication AlreadyExists race to the typed destination refusals
acceptance: When another writer creates the destination between the existence check and the no-replace move, task-sync directory publication returns task_sync_destination_appeared (write_with) or task_sync_destination_occupied (the other writers) instead of a raw AlreadyExists I/O error, still keeping the existing entry and removing the stage; a test injects the race
